nodes/sop/scatter.title: Scatter
nodes/sop/scatter.summary: Places points at random over a surface, or inside a volume.

nodes/sop/copytopoints.title: Copy to Points
nodes/sop/copytopoints.summary: Puts a copy of one geometry on every point of another.

nodes/sop/attribwrangle.title: Attribute Wrangle
nodes/sop/attribwrangle.summary: Runs a VEX snippet on every point, primitive or vertex.

vex/functions/noise.title: noise
vex/functions/noise.summary: Smooth noise in one to four dimensions, between 0 and 1.

nodes/sop/box.title: Box
nodes/sop/box.summary: Makes a box, or a box that fits around its input.
